main.note: main at October 26; verify the pinned SHA before each retirement, refresh if main changes

development.note: development descends from main; divergences require explicit provenance/gates and recent intent, not just branch age

precedence: Existing tested main implementation and current user-approved behavior win over older incomplete experiments by default.
A newer, explicit, user-approved direction may supersede main only after scoped tests and review; development is an integration candidate, not an automatic production authority.
File/commit recency is evidence, not proof; semantic intent and functional behavior can override chronology.
Retire only refs without open PR, protection or unpreserved unique contributions; store exact blob snapshots of material artifacts and tag original entire DAG before branch deletion.
Retirement batches remain SHA-pinned (max 3 refs); pass independent audit and readback; preserve main, DS02 and PR #34; no automatic Netlify deployment.
Security/auth/DTO and unreconciled browser/visual changes remain HOLD even if their branches are old.
exception: The development-only V5 buyer DTO privacy improvement requires its own gated review before promotion to main. No implied main replacement.
